about: Every check the scanner runs. The scanner modules, skill/references/checks.md, the Route 5 proposals and the bot's knowledge files are all built from this file. Change a check here first.

checks.remedy: uses the first Heading 1, else the file name made readable
checks.template_fix: Set the title in the template's document properties.

checks.remedy: only with the language the owner names (`en-US`, `es-ES`); the tool never guesses one
checks.template_fix: Set the default language in the template's styles.

checks.finding: Image with no alt text, or alt text that is a filename or an auto-generated phrase
checks.looks_at: alt text present and not a filename or auto-generated phrase
checks.remedy: Draft one sentence, or offer "decorative". Author confirms
checks.proposal: Write one sentence saying what this image conveys in this course, or mark it decorative if it conveys nothing. The tool cannot know which.
checks.template_fix: If the same image is in every file (a logo, a banner), set its alt text or mark it decorative in the template.

checks.finding: Bold short line used as a heading
checks.looks_at: bold lines styled as body text
checks.remedy: the tool proposes level 2; the author confirms both that it is a heading and the level, and the id is passed with the level they named
checks.proposal: If this is a section heading, apply a Heading style at the right level.
checks.template_fix: Put Heading styles on the template's section titles so copies inherit them.

checks.finding: No heading styles in a long document
checks.looks_at: heading styles present in a long document
checks.remedy: Author marks the section titles; no tool fix
checks.proposal: Apply Heading styles to the section titles. The tool cannot decide which lines are sections.
checks.template_fix: Put Heading styles on the template's section titles so copies inherit them.

checks.remedy: Author chooses: fix the level or restructure; no tool fix
checks.proposal: Use the next heading level here, or restructure the sections above.
checks.template_fix: Fix the heading levels in the template's outline once.

checks.finding: Empty heading (a Heading style with no text)
checks.remedy: Author deletes it or gives it the section's title
checks.proposal: Delete the empty heading, or give it the section's title.
checks.template_fix: Remove the empty heading from the template; every copy inherited it.

checks.finding: Table with no header row marked
checks.remedy: only if the first row really holds column names
checks.proposal: If the first row holds column names, mark it as a repeating header row. If the table is used for layout, convert it to text.
checks.template_fix: Mark the header row in the template's table style, once.

checks.finding: Link text that says nothing ("click here", a bare URL)
checks.remedy: Author replaces it with the destination's name
checks.proposal: Replace the link text with the name of the destination, e.g. the page or document title.
checks.template_fix: Fix the shared link text in the template or the source the files copy from.

checks.remedy: uses the first slide title, else the file name
checks.template_fix: Set the title in the slide master's presentation properties.

checks.finding: Slide without a title placeholder with text
checks.looks_at: every slide has a title placeholder with text
checks.remedy: Author gives each slide a unique title; it may be visually hidden but must exist
checks.proposal: Give the slide a unique title in the title placeholder. It may be visually hidden, but it must exist.
checks.template_fix: Give every layout in the slide master a title placeholder.

checks.finding: Picture with no alt text, or alt text that is a filename or an auto-generated phrase
checks.looks_at: alt text on pictures present and not a filename or auto-generated phrase
checks.remedy: Draft one sentence, or offer "decorative". Author confirms
checks.proposal: Write one sentence saying what this picture conveys on this slide, or mark it decorative.
checks.template_fix: If the same image is on every slide (a logo), set its alt text or mark it decorative in the slide master.

checks.finding: Table with no header row marked
checks.remedy: only if the first row really holds column names
checks.proposal: If the first row holds column names, mark it as the header row. If the table is used for layout, replace it with text boxes.
checks.template_fix: Mark the header row in the slide master's table style.

checks.remedy: from the file name, since the tool does not read a PDF's structure; glance at the result
checks.template_fix: Set the title in the source files; the export carries it.

checks.remedy: only with the language the owner names
checks.template_fix: Set the language in the source files; the export carries it.

checks.finding: File is not tagged at all
checks.looks_at: the file is tagged at all
checks.remedy: **None in this tool.** Re-export from the source file after fixing it there. If there is no source, the file needs Acrobat's auto-tag followed by a human check
checks.proposal: Re-export from the source Word or PowerPoint file after fixing it there; the export carries the tags. If there is no source, this file needs Acrobat's auto-tag followed by a human check. This tool cannot build a tag tree.
checks.template_fix: Fix the export: 'Document structure tags for accessibility' on in Word and PowerPoint.

checks.finding: Pages are images with no text
checks.looks_at: the first pages carry extractable text, not only images
checks.remedy: Find the original, or OCR and then check the recognised text against the page
checks.proposal: Find the original document, or run OCR and then check the recognized text against the page.
checks.template_fix: Find what these files have in common and fix it there.
